programme.title: S1E3 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. programme.desc: Chasing El Niño follows Chris Benchetler on an epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the vast slopes of British Columbia. This episode captures the thrill of exploration, friendship, and the relentless pursuit of epic lines.

Chris and his crew hike 6,000 vertical feet through rugged rock fields to chase the last snow of the season in the Sierras, pushing their limits and capturing every thrilling moment.

programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Lucha
programme.desc: Ian Hodgkinson, known as Vampiro in the world of wrestling, was a famed wrestler in the late 80’s and 90’s. Today, he shifted his career to being behind the scenes as a Story Producer for AAA, the top wrestling company in Lucha Libre. Hodgkinson intimately peels back the curtain on the mysteries of this show, how it’s produced, and what life is like on and off the stage. We dive deep in to the lives of two wrestlers and follow their stories as they prep for their next fight: El Hijo Del Fantasma, an up and coming star who seemingly has it all, as well as Faby Apache, a veteran female wrestler struggling to stay relevant as she raises her son.

programme.title: S1E2 Lucha

programme.title: Trick Shots Ep. 9
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Globetrotters History Ep. 1
programme.desc: Celebrating the legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters with iconic profiles and unforgettable moments as we journey through decades of dazzling skills, humor, and global impact.

programme.title: A Routine Haircut
programme.desc: Wham, Too Tall and Torch team up with gymnast Nia Dennis to inspire a diverse group of young gymnasts in Pasadena; Speedy invites Thunder and Bulldog to his hometown of Philadelphia to give back to a barber who provides haircuts to the homeless.

programme.title: My Rookie Season Ep. 3
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies while fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: Sunshine Day
programme.desc: TNT alongside Jet and his daughter realize just how precious the simple things are on the shores of Sebago Lake. TNT and Torch reminisce on their early days of blazing the trail for a new generation of female Globetrotters. And TNT doesn't look twice as she sinks an amazing shot in New York's famous Rucker Park. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: Best Young Athletes: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This video features highlights and introductions to some of the most talented and athletic Harlem Globetrotters players. It showcases their incredible skills, unique athleticism, and entertaining performances, emphasizing their dedication, character, and the legacy of the team. The Globetrotters demonstrate jaw-dropping moves, impressive vertical jumps, and their signature showmanship, celebrating their milestone of 20,000 games played worldwide.

programme.title: Dunks Ep. 1
programme.desc: The best dunks from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Loveland CO 2020
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was from 2020 and played in Loveland, CO.

programme.title: The People of the Globe: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: At the LA Sports Arena, the Globetrotters showcase their newest generation of talent while honoring 75 years of tradition.

programme.title: Trick Shots Ep. 10
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Catching Waves
programme.desc: Hotshot, Hammer and Cheese hit the beach with some amazing foster kids and their chosen family. Hotshot takes Cheese along with him as they provide eager documentary students with an insider's perspective of the hidden stories of Harlem. And Kevin DeBruin illuminates the science behind Torch’s signature trick shot. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: New Teammates
programme.desc: Coach Lou joins Hammer, Bulldog, and the team to learn about the history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters from their humble beginnings in Chicago. Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway and the Globetrotters remember some of their favorite places from around the world. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Red, White & Blue: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This content showcases the legendary Harlem Globetrotters, highlighting their 70-year history of thrilling audiences worldwide with their unique blend of basketball skill, athleticism, and entertainment. It features iconic moments, fan interactions, and tributes to the team’s legacy and key figures who helped shape the global basketball phenomenon.

programme.title: 100 Years of the Harlem Globetrotters: Mandela & Magic

programme.title: Mr. Basketball’s Journey: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This documentary-style content chronicles the rich history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters, from their founding in 1926 to their rise as world-class athletes and entertainers. It highlights their groundbreaking 1948 victory over the Minneapolis Lakers, which helped legitimize black athletes in professional basketball. The story focuses on Mannie Jackson, a former player turned executive, who saved the team from extinction in the 1990s and revitalized their global brand. The Globetrotters’ influence on basketball, their unique blend of comedy and athleticism, and their philanthropic efforts around the world are also showcased, cementing their place as an iconic basketball and entertainment institution.

programme.desc: This video features the Harlem Globetrotters showcasing their legendary basketball skills and entertaining performances. In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.
After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure.
From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Nova Project
programme.desc: Bryan does some welding on a 66 Nova while Kevin takes a trip to the dyno to dial in the new EFI system for the small block engine.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - No Smoking
programme.desc: Bryan tightens the bumper on a 1969 Chevy Van and Kevin lights a fire with the wrong gauge wire.

programme.title: Truck U - Tundra Look-Alike
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno bring in a pair of Toyota Tundra’s. The only problem, what truck gets what parts? Let the competition begin.

programme.title: Truck U - Ford EcoBoost
programme.desc: Its our first look at the Ford EcoBoost V6 engine, and we don’t leave anything stock. We’ll keep the more efficient engine and add some power today on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U - Federated Work Truck
programme.desc: Why build a regular work truck, when you can build the Ultimate Work Truck. Our challenge today is to take a stock 2013 Silverado and outfit it from head to toe, and when we’re done, we’re giving it away.

programme.title: Truck U - TruckUbicon
programme.desc: We start with a 2012 stock Jeep JK and build it up to get ready to go off-road only at the massive Jeep Beach Event at Daytona International speedway.

programme.title: Truck U - Jeep Beach Event
programme.desc: Our Truck Ubicon Jeep Beach Rig is done. Now it’s time to use it. We'll hit the obstacles at Daytona Motor Speedway and see some of the coolest rigs along the way.

programme.title: Truck U - Injector Maintenance
programme.desc: Why spend thousands, when you can do it yourself. Bruno and Matt show you how to fix faulty injectors on a Ford F250 Diesel.

programme.title: Truck U - Strom Trooper Ford
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno take a stock Ford Truck and turn it in to a very cool one-off, all-white Storm Trooper Ford.

programme.title: Truck U - Play Toys
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno show you some cool upgrades for your Razor UTV. Then it’s time to strap the toys down and hit the trail.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Maintenance Show
programme.desc: Bryan and Kevin put a stop to the shakes on a 2006 Nissan. Also find out what happened when a graffiti artist put his mark on our garage.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Transmission Components
programme.desc: Bryan and Kevin marry an engine transmission and work on patch panels for the Nova project.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Factory Five Tour
programme.desc: Ride along with Kevin Byrd as he takes a pilgrimage to Plymouth with some of his Factory Five friends.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Wiring Demons
programme.desc: 1967 Camaro wiring issues get cleaned up.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - The Inhaler
programme.desc: The Impala is back and ready to breath with a new Kinsler intake.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - The Fueller
programme.desc: Bryan rips apart a brand new Buelle to give it the Fuller touch.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Sam’s New Cummins
programme.desc: Sam Memmolo is back to match wits with Kevin about the new 6.7 diesel Cummins.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Challenging Exhaust
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan install a new exhaust kit on a new Challenger and then start work on Bryan’s 33 getting it ready for a chop.

programme.title: Truck U - Resto Update
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno find a 1971 Chevy Truck that needs a major restoration update. This truck gets transformed inside and out to feel 30 years younger.

programme.title: Truck U - Trick it or Trade it
programme.desc: Nobody wants a truck payment. But, everyone wants the newest technology. Matt and Bruno show you how to get your older truck up to date without trading it in on the new model.

programme.title: Truck U - Hog Hunting Bronco
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno find the perfect hunting truck, the only problem is they need to get it running before they can go on their first hunt.

programme.title: Truck U - Mall Crawler
programme.desc: Some build Jeeps to go off-road, and others build them just for the “off-road” look. Matt and Bruno will show you how to build the ultimate “Mall Crawler” on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U - SuperCharged Raptor
programme.desc: How can you jump a Ford Raptor even further? Put a supercharger in it. Matt and Bruno team up with Roush Performance to get the maximum power output of a stock Raptor.

programme.title: Truck U - Vintage CJ
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt find a vintage CJ Jeep and see if they can transform it back to its former glory.

programme.title: Truck U - Bruno Goes Racing
programme.desc: Bruno goes racing in Charlotte, North Carolina. First, he finds out how a NASCAR team is run at Michael Waltrip Racing; then he checks out a NHRA test session at zMAX Dragway.

programme.title: Truck U - Wired and Fired
programme.desc: Every Project starts with a Cab and Chassis. On Truck U will show you what to look for when finding the right cab and get a small block engine wired and fired.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Under the Knife
programme.desc: Bryan finally gets to fulfill his dream of chopping the top on his 33.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Factory Five Build Part 1 - the Engine
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan begin work on a new Factory Five Hot Rod with a Dart 369 engine build

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Factory Five Build Part 2 - the Body
programme.desc: Bryan and Kevin get the body on their Factory Five Hot Rod

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Factory Five Build Part 3 - the Test
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan finish their five-day Factory Five project and take their car to the streets.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Welding Tips
programme.desc: Learn some Mig and Tig welding tips as the guys finish the roll cage and do some patch panels on the Fuller Hot Rod Project.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Custom Camaro
programme.desc: How do you a make a 2010 SS throw back Camaro look even better. Drop it off with Kevin and Bryan and see what happens.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - SuperNova
programme.desc: Kevin installs a new wiring harness while Bryan welds up a new exhaust for our Nova.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - See it Made - Magnaflow
programme.desc: Kevin visits Magnaflow to see what it takes to get that perfect sounding exhaust.

programme.title: Truck U - Daily Driver
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the bed of a 1966 Chevy truck.

programme.title: Truck U - Food Truck
programme.desc: The world’s largest food truck rally comes to Truck U. Matt and Bruno find a Food Truck that is need of some repair and in the process give the truck a whole new look.

programme.title: Truck U - Fisherman’s Fleet
programme.desc: A local seafood distributor is ready to grow his business and Truck U is ready to help. Matt and Bruno find a truck, find a work bed and fill it up with seafood.

programme.title: Truck U - UTV Fun
programme.desc: Can Am Commanders are perfect for work and play. On Truck U we do a little of both.

programme.title: Truck U - Signature Series Jeep
programme.desc: When 4 Wheel Parts ask Truck U to build a signature series Jeep, we said yes. We’ll add a long arm suspension kit with 37 inch tires and take the new JK off-road.

programme.title: Truck U - Ultimate Chase Truck
programme.desc: Desert Race Teams need support when they’re in the middle of nowhere. We’ll help one of those teams, by turning a stock Raptor SVT into the Ultimate Chase Truck.

programme.title: Truck U - Diesel Puller
programme.desc: When it takes almost 900 horsepower to pull a pro sled truck down a track, things are going to break. Truck U steps in, to take out broken axles and upgrade them for good.

programme.title: Truck U - Show and Go
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno bring in a 1982 GMC that has a lot of show and even more go. They’ll do some custom modifications to the Cummins engine and dress up the exterior.

programme.title: Hemi Orange is the New Corporate Blue - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls work on a 1968 GTX for Bill Goldberg, and Mark repairs a Challenger deck lid. Will paints a 1967 Hemi GTX and challenges Mark to a paint-off.

programme.title: Grand Theft Hemi - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark teaches Allysa to analyze and document cars in preparation for disassembly, but she later has a crucial lapse in judgement. The ghouls install the 400 Magnum in the 1972 Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Investigation O.E. - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Two rare Mopars, a Daytona survivor and early Hemi Charger, are analyzed for authenticity and restoration.

programme.title: Chally vs. Chally - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls complete the 1970 V-Code Challenger and make a side-by-side comparison with Mark's 2014 Shaker-hood Challenger.

programme.title: HEMI FK5 Alive - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Hemi Charger is restored.

programme.title: Pitch and Rides - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The 1970 Hemi Charger project is completed in the season finale.

programme.title: General Assemble Lee - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.

programme.title: Put Up Your Dukes - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

programme.title: General Deliver Lee - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s a delivery day at Graveyard Carz! We jump back and show you every moment in the restoration of our legendary, screen-used, record holding, General Lee from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film. It all builds to a reveal the Duke Boys would be proud of.

programme.title: Inner Workings of a Victim - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

programme.title: Dueling Drivetrains - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With Mark out of the shop looking at a potential new location for a Mopar car-dealership, the Graveyard Ghouls begin the drivetrain assembly’s for a 1970 Lime Light Tribute Superbird and our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger.

programme.title: Getting Schooled - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark the the Graveyard Ghouls race against the clock to finish up some last-minute tasks on their various Mopar restorations before traveling north to judge Little Creek Casino’s epic car show.

programme.title: Roadrunner With a Twist - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s another reveal day! Mark and Allysa install the graphics on the ’71 Plumb Crazy Challenger and the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner is finished and readied to be delivered to it’s owner. And Mark proposes - what he thinks is - a “brilliant” idea to the producers of the show.

programme.title: Engines, Assemblies, and Dougie, Oh My! - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger nearing completion, works shifts to our 1970 Tribute Superbird while Mark and Cousin Dougie build out a 340 engine and Will assists with metal work with George to help him stay on schedule.

programme.title: I Love the Smell of Plum Crazy in the Morning - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s a special day at Graveyard Carz. The 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger that has been part of our show since its inception is finally finished and ready to be shipped to it’s new owner. But before they do that, they take it to the coast to show it off at Chinook Winds Casino Resort Car Show!

programme.title: Gone in 60 Days - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Work ramps up on our 1970 Tribute Superbird and just when things couldn’t get more stressful, Mark has taken on a new project - a 1969 GTX owned by non other than Chris Jacobs, host of Overhaulin’. Not only does Chris want the car restored to it’s former glory, he wants it to be completed in time for SEMA 2017 - only sixty days away!

programme.title: Mopardy - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Stress is high at the shop and things don’t get any better when Mark finds out that Tony from Tony’s Mopar Parts has secretly flown out to check in on the progress of his 1970 Challenger. Knowing that the restoration hasn’t started, Mark does everything in his power to distract Tony while Cousin Dougie races to disassemble his car.

programme.title: A Buck Shorted - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: SEMA 2017 is fast approaching and the Graveyard Ghouls are working hard on Chris Jacob’s 1969 GTX and John Buck’s 1971 Challenger with a Hellcrate Hemi. But as pressure begins to mount, Mark questions if he’ll be able to keep his promised - and ultimately - is forced to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: The Phoenix 'Cuda - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Phoenix Cuda: A legendary Mopar which was incinerated and from the ashes, will be reborn at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Family Truckster Restoration Part 2
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides tips and techniques for restoring dull, faded paint using a forced-rotation dual action polisher along with a graphene 3-in-1 ceramic polish, along with severe scratch and scuff removal.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Family Truckster Restoration Part 3
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how super clean automotive upholstery, as well as the proper chemicals and detailing tools for deep cleaning vinyl and rubber surfaces.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - FEAD System
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan tear up a motor to see the importance of the serpentine belt.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - 2011 Mustang
programme.desc: Kevin takes us through variable cam timing in Ford’s new 5.0L power plant.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Café Racer Gets Jets
programme.desc: Fuller and Byrd bring back the Café Racer Honda bike and show you how to open up the jets in the carburetor for better performance.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Turbo Technology
programme.desc: We look at the technology behind turbochargers and intercoolers as we install some upgrades on a F250 Super Duty.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Operation Comfort
programme.desc: Bryan takes a trip to San Antonio to teach some of our nations heroes how to weld.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Cold Air, Hot Rod
programme.desc: We tackle an A/C cooling problem on a Toyota Tacoma and introduce you to Kevin’s Hot Rod BMW.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - LSM3
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan continue the work on Kevin’s LSM3 project.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Inside the Cat
programme.desc: Kevin travels to Indiana to solve the mysteries of the catalytic converter.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 101
programme.desc: A California collector gambles on a big payday from his Crocker/Caddy combo.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 102
programme.desc: “The Century Race”: Dale believes he found the bike that will help him beat a rival in an annual race of 100 year old motorcycles. But will it run?

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 103
programme.desc: “A Motorcycle Crime Story”: The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 104
programme.desc: “Yes, Dale there is a 100 Year Old Harley”: Dale hopes his labor of love becomes a prized possession when a six-figure Harley goes to auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 105
programme.desc: A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 106
programme.desc: A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A trend is on the rise: going on mountain cruises in a sports car. As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: The teams gather in Albaida in Spain for the opening round of the 2025 supermoto season, the Grand Prix of Comunitat Valenciana.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: The competition moves to Italy where Round 2, the Grand Prix of Sardegna, takes place in Tramatza on the island of Sardinia.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: The third round, the Grand Prix of Germany, takes us to the town of St. Wendel in the Saarland region.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Round 4, the Grand Prix of Hungary, takes us to the town of Visonta in the north-eastern part of the country.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Busca in the Piemonte region of Italy is the location of the fifth round of this year's competition.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: The teams head to Mettet in the Wallonia region in Belgium for the seventh and final round of the 2025 season, the Grand Prix of Belgium.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: For Round 6, the S1GP of Nations, the teams head to Vysoké Mýto in the Czech Republic.

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider
programme.desc: Wir fahren mit dem McLaren 570S Spider ein wenig durchs Gebirge und geniessen den schönen Tag.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka is a racing junkie and constantly takes part in such events. US car fans Kati and Patrick join him for the Race 61, a rock and race festival in Finowfurt near Berlin. There Frank and and his Dragster Camaro take part in the 1/8 mile race.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: German entrepeneur Tillmann Miritz loves vintage cars and has a dream: driving through the USA in his Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5. He drives along the picturesque French Riviera and visits a classic car collector before his 280 gets shipped.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Tillmann starts his dream journey in New York, the city that never sleeps. With his Mercedes 280 SE convertible he visits the legendary classic car dealer Eliot Cuker who made his fortune with his passion for old cars.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Mitsubishi Outlander Plug-In Hybrid, the world's first hybrid SUV with two electric motors and a 2-liter combustion engine. Also: the Chevrolet Silverado, an American full-size pickup with a V8 and an average consumption of at least 15 liters.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Bentley EXP 9F and Jaguar C-X17 are concept cars the two manufacturers presented before they started making their own luxury SUVs. Also: how did Toyota, Nissan or Subaru see the future of the SUV? And: Mercedes-Benz' Unimog concept car.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The SUVs Nissan X-Trail and BMW X4 aren't typical offroaders. We witnessed the presentation of the new X-Trail model and BMW's premiere of their X4. Also: the Steinbeißer Trophy, where unusual offroad vehicles take part in a demanding rally.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Volvo XC60
programme.desc: The Swedish landscape is characterized by mountains, forests and lonely roads. Ideal for this off-roader. The Volvo XC60 scores with many safety features and a cool appearance.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode features Action Concept's stunt highlights from all previous specials, from exciting car stunts to meticulously choreographed fight scenes and even some snowmobile shootout action.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In a race between a dump truck and a car, man and machine are brought to their limits. Stuntman Stefan receives a load of gravel for his birthday, instead of confetti.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: The Ferrari California T has a lot of Italian passion and elegant lines to offer. Super sports car cabriolets are popular all over the world. It is no wonder that more and more manufacturers are 'opening up'.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Lake Faaker is both a popular holiday spot in Austria and also a place with a special tradition. In early September, the region is the destination for thousands of bikers who celebrate their big annual event, the European Bike Week. (Part 1 of 5)

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Lake Faaker is both a popular holiday spot in Austria and also a place with a special tradition. In early September, the region is the destination for thousands of bikers who celebrate their big annual event, the European Bike Week. (Part 2 of 5)

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Lake Faaker is both a popular holiday spot in Austria and also a place with a special tradition. In early September, the region is the destination for thousands of bikers who celebrate their big annual event, the European Bike Week. (Part 3 of 5)

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Lake Faaker is both a popular holiday spot in Austria and also a place with a special tradition. In early September, the region is the destination for thousands of bikers who celebrate their big annual event, the European Bike Week. (Part 4 of 5)

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Lake Faaker is both a popular holiday spot in Austria and also a place with a special tradition. In early September, the region is the destination for thousands of bikers who celebrate their big annual event, the European Bike Week. (Part 5 of 5)

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: At the Essen Motor Show over 500 exhibitors present the latest highlights from the car tuning scene. Everything can be found here, from accessories available to everyone to handmade sports cars and top class tuning.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Abt Sportsline stands for car tuning at the highest level. Abt's slogan isn't 'from the race track to the road ' for nothing. Also: the Rohte VW Golf R20. And: the BMW Art Car.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: We visited Brabus, the largest independent automobile tuner where you can find more than 9,000 HP in one place. Also: MTM's Audi RS6 Clubsport.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Berlin-based company TH Automobiles equips Volkswagen vans with Porsche engines, turning a T5 into one of the most dynamic large saloon cars in the world.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Conti Tuning Day is themed "Power Sedans" and we take a closer look at the cars on display. Plus: Swiss eccentric Ueli Anliker has built the most expensive Mercedes-AMG SLR in the world, the "Red Gold Dream".

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Gemballa specialises in refining Porsche models, but its portfolio also includes brands such as Ferrari. And: the car tuning company Irmscher turns the Chevrolet Camaro into the 'Irmscher Camaro i42'.

programme.title: Porsche 550 RS Spyder
programme.desc: Small, lightweight, agile and swift as an arrow. Historic image documents of the Porsche 550 RS Spyder.

programme.title: BMW 750i xDrive
programme.desc: The BMW 750i is the second most powerful car in the 7 series. It may be mercilessly overpowered for the daily commute to work, but thanks to this power the two-ton vehicle doesn't feel as heavy as it actually is.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What better way is there to celebrate a stylish and powerful car and a sunny summer day than going for a cruise over the Alps to Italy in a Maserati GranCabrio MC? In addition: a Brit with a fiery temperament, the Jaguar XK-RS convertible with 550 hp. And: Mercedes AMG's SL models, uncompromising performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In a city that loves to show off wealth and luxury, the Dubai police are eager to represent this image via its fleet of patrol cars that includes a Chevrolet Camaro, a Lamborghini Aventador, a Bentley GT, a Ferrari FF, an Aston Martin and a Mercedes SLS. For the first time ever, the Dubai Police Special Cars Unit allowed a television crew to accompany them on their service missions.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Aerodynamics crucially influence the performance, track stability and dynamics of a vehicle. We took the Porsche 911 Turbo S, the BMW M6 convertible and the Kelleners 330d to the test and explored the influence of different wings and spoilers.

programme.title: Audi R8 V10 plus
programme.desc: The second generation of the Audi R8. V10 naturally aspirated engine, up to 610 horsepower and 330 kilometers an hour. A supercar with a lot of character.

programme.title: Audi RS7 Sportback Performance
programme.desc: The Audi RS7 Sportback performance is the spearhead of the Audi 7 series with the acceleration values of a super sports car. But it cannot play to its strengths in hectic urban traffic.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The Nürburgring is the place where you can really let your hair down on a spectacular and difficult race track and learn how to get fit for motor sports. This is the reason why motoring enthusiasts go there throughout the year.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: We prepared some very entertaining clips from the Nürburgring for you. Expect to see the pedal on the metal and rubber burning.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: When the weather cleared up a bit at the Nürburgring, we were finally back at the track. As soon as the snow and ice were gone the horsepower junkies returned to the ring to once again let their engines roar.

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: The Ferrari California T has a lot of Italian passion and elegant lines to offer. Super sports car cabriolets are popular all over the world. It is no wonder that more and more manufacturers are 'opening up'.

programme.title: Chevrolet Caprice 9C1 police car
programme.desc: This 1994 Chevrolet Caprice 9C1 is a former police car from the Los Angeles Police Department. Its curvaceous body was often mocked as looking like a whale, but this Chevy Caprice possesses the qualities of a shark.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Subaru shows the new facelift of their former rally car WRX STi. Also: it's small, economical and an iconic car, the Fiat 500 with its Twin-Air engine. And: the Mercedes ML 350 BlueTEC 4MATIC.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Huge power and lightning-fast accelleration without any engine sound, the Tesla Roadster Sport. Also: engine sound design for the Audi R8 e-tron. And: MTM specialises in tuning Audi cars.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Infiniti, Nissan's luxury division, is stepping up in order to make the brand a global success, starting with their FX50 SUV. Also: Audi introduce the hybrid version of their top dog model A8. And: Mercedes-AMG's C63 Black Series.

programme.title: Arabella Classics
programme.desc: Rare Automobiles and stunning views! The Arabella Classics, one of the most exclusive Classic Car Rallies in Europe.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Changing your car like your underwear is possible now. With Book by Cadillac, customers can ask for unlimited vehicle changes with no additional costs. Also: Volvo presents the Polestar 1 as its first electric car. Additional plug-in hybrids will follow until 2020.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Tucson is Hyundai's bestseller. Does the new equipment line N-Line turn the Korean car into an athlete? Also: 2018 saw the launch of the 12th generation of the Toyota Corolla. And: will the T-Cross also become a Volkswagen bestseller?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: SUVs are hot sellers, grabbing 54% of Europe’s market in 2024. Compact SUVs lead the trend, and the Dacia Bigster shakes things up — around 10,000 Euros cheaper than rivals. But is it a real deal or just cheap with nothing behind it?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Size matters! Many families would agree. With the XM, BMW's M division treats itself for its 50th anniversary to a true colossus for families with certain demands. And: The all-electric KIA EV9 in our family test.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Our reporter Verena steers a Piaggio Ape through the streets of Verona, race driver Patrick Simon tries to master the Lamborghini Gallardo and we explore some rules of Italian traffic law when it comes to drinking and driving.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Verena takes part in a kart race against former Formula 1 driver Hans-Joachim Stuck and his two sons. We also take a look at the career of Stuck and other racing legends and put a souped-up Mini Cooper to the test.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo
programme.desc: We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: The search for the fastest, best looking and best sounding car continues. Once more car lovers from the Middle East bring their tuned vehicles to the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach and have it judged by Saif Hattawi. The winner receives a special treat for two people from the luxurious Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. A Ford Mustang and a limited edition Chevrolet Corvette try to win the competition.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Put Your Car on TV gives every car owner the chance to bring their tuned machines to the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah beach. There, Saif Hattawi will assess each car based on speed, style and sound. The person with the most amazing car wins a one night stay at the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah Beach for two people. A BMW X6M, a massive Ford F250 and a special Nissan Patrol try to win this prize.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: The Walk' at JBR, the most prestigious location in Dubai, sets the background for the fastest customized cars in the Middle East. Put Your Car on TV invites car owners to present their cars and have it judged. The owner of the fastest, most beautiful and best sounding car wins a special treat from Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the competitors are a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Once more, Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi are on the hunst for the most amazing cars in the world and ask car owners to bring their customized vehicles to Dubai, where it will be awarded points based on speed, style and sound. The car with the points wins a stay at the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah Beach for two people. Among the presented cars are a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car on TV people from the Middle East present their tuned vehicles. They are rewarded with points based on its styling, the highest (possible) speed ever driven und naturally also its sound. Whoever receives the most points, wins a luxurious treat from the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. This time, a Lexus GSF, a Ford Mustang and a McLaren MP4-12C are put on the spotlight.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We present to you historic image and film documents from the Porsche 550 RS Spyder. And: how the Audi Quattro shocked its competitors with its driving dynamics.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: High-tech turbo cars from the wild 1980s are reunited at the Salzburgring race track. Also: the Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, a small Italian two-seater with mid-engine offers classic car driving pleasure at a low entry price.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Audi Quattro
programme.desc: Advantage through Technology on rally tracks. The Audi Quattro shocks opponents.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We took the Ferrari 458 Italia for a spring ride around Lake Starnberg. Also: a test drive of BMW's 6 series convertible at the Table Mountain in South Africa. And: the Chevrolet Orlando family van.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Audi built only 333 units of its GT model. We tested the everyday use compatibility of the R8 GT. In addition: the Mazda MX5, the most popular roadster in the world. And: the Mercedes-AMG GT3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Kati and Patrick from Munich are no longer satisfied with their 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle's 5.7-liter small block and want to buy a bigger engine. For that reason they visit the engine specialists from Down Town Garage for a proper conversion.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Paaren/Glien near Berlin is host to the yearly Oldtimer Show. Frank and his crew from Special Cars Berlin take their Dragster Camaro to the airfield where high performance cars battle it out in a 1/8 mile race. Will Frank be able to defy the competition?

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: With more than 500 featured super sports cars by Lamborghini, Ferrari, Bugatti or Koenigsegg, Germany is home to the world's largest Supercar Rallye. US car fans Kati and her husband Patrick take part in this event with a brand new Chevrolet Camaro.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Jaguar E-Type is a century-old sports car whose look still quickens the pulse today. Those responsible at Jaguar waited almost 40 years before they dared to build a successor to one of the most beautiful cars in the world.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The early history of sports car manufacturer Lamborghini was shaped by the rivalry between tractor manufacturer Ferruccio Lamborghini and Enzo Ferrari. Over the years, the brand launched some of the most striking sports cars in the world.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The 1960s and 1970s were golden years for Opel. Ascona, Manta, Rekord and GT, an Opel was more than just a car, and the company built one classic after another. Today, these car models are all icons.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz S-Class has set the standard in the luxury class. The status model of the rich, famous and powerful prevails against crises, social change and all competitors.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The BMW 3 Series is the epitome of a sports saloon. Since its debut in 1975, it has been the undisputed leader of the premium segment. It's a family saloon, a sports car, a tuning object and a racing car.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The sound of the McLaren 720S Spider is that of an uncompromising driving machine. Also: the F-Pace SVR makes a rather sophisticated impression. And: is the Porsche Cayenne coupe's higher price justifiable compared to the regular model?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: How much power is there in the Limited Edition of the Seat Cupra Ateca? Also: are the Porsche 718 Boxster and the Cayman in the GTS version an alternative to the expensive 911? And: the exclusive preview of Audi's RS6 powerful station wagon.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Does the Skoda Enyaq Coupe RS iV live up to the famous "Rally Sport" abbreviation in its model designation as an e-car? And how does Mercedes-AMG manage without the brand's usual V8 sound in the EQE 53?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two car brands turn their drive concepts upside down: for the first time since the 1980s, Maserati builds a mid-engine sports car. And Corvette's C8 with mid-engine instead of classic front-wheel drive redefines the American Dream.

programme.title: UFA 500 - SFT Combat 63
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT Combat 63 from Sao Paolo, Brazil. Up first, an Xtreme fight in the heavyweight division between Pedro Orlando and Breno Souza and in the flyweight division, Paulo Andre and Bruno Brito step into the cage. In an Xtreme Karate bout, Caique Korchak faces Luiz Soares plus in an MMA catchweight bout, Joab Baianinho and Vitor Showman faceoff. In an Xtreme female matchup, Maju Bertin and Giovanna Bonanome take to the cage in what's expected to be a striking battle.

programme.title: UFA 501 - Dynamite Fighting Show 32 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Polivalentă in Iași, Romania. This episode features the semi-final matchups in the DFS - K1 90 kilo World Grand Prix tournament with Vasile Corcodel facing Sebastian Lutaniuc and Becali Bodescu taking on Aaron Măcăilă. Next up is a Super Fight lighetweight match between Denisa Vulpe from Romania and Maria Chișcă of Maldova. In another Super Fight bout, Spain's Bubu Ndow steps into the ring with Romanian Andrei Leuștean.

programme.title: UFA 502 - Dynamite Fighting Show 32 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 The Battle of Moldova from the Sala Polivalentă in Iași, Romania. Starting off is a Superfight in the lightweight division between Emi Lupașcu and Damir Popovici followed by a Suprfight in the Super Middleweight division with Tudor Potoroacă versus Francesco Carbotti. This episode also features the Championship matchup in the DFS - K1 90 kilo World Grand Prix tournament, the winner will move on to comptete in the World Grand Prix in Japan. In the main event is Florin Lambagiu versus Cristian Ristea - it's the Gladiator versus Rambo with 40 knockouts betweeen them facing off in a Superfight in the open weight division.

programme.title: UFA 503 - Rage Kombat: Rebellion
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Rage Kombat - Rebellion from Malta and features Boxing, Kudo and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. In a Malta vs UK contest, Christian Schembri takes on George Watson in the Super Middleweight division. Next up Danil Kotlyar and Nichita Mazurcheviciis step into the ring in a featured event with the special art of Kudo. Christian Danilo Guido of Italy takes on Libya's Moez Zinad in a boxing match and in the Super Bantamweight division Bray Pace takes on Callum Goodison. The main event features Brandon Borg and Kaine Burns in a cruiserweight boxing contest.

programme.title: UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.

programme.title: UFA 492 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 3 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a flyweight bout, Artur Arutyunyan faces Josh Pavia and Narek Avagyan steps into the cage with Rodney Kealohi. In the main event, the Rising Stars Lightweight Belt is on the line when the undefeated Izac Enriquez puts his title on the line against Weston Quiroz.

programme.title: UFA 355 - CFC Mursa Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 1 from Malta. In a four man tournament, Jonathan Carlos out of Brazil who is on a winning streak faces Argentinian Matias Juarez. Next up two Brazilians battle to move on in the tournament as Joao Luis Nogueira takes on Felipe Douglas.

programme.title: UFA 356 - CFC Mursa Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 16 Mursa part 2 from Malta. In a boxing contest, Italian Damiano Calicchia gets in the cage with Cleavin Falzon of Malta. Also, watch as the winners of the semi-finals four man tournament battle for the win to move on to the championship in Brazil.

programme.title: UFA 408 - Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. Watch as two undefeated super welterweights, Steve Cunningham Jr. (son of world champion fighter) and Rudy Reveles head to the ring. Also in this episode is the Shadow Fightgoods 140 pound tournament final, Elijah Williams and Dion Jones vye for the win.

programme.title: UFA 410 - Red Owl BoxFest XII part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XII part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. In tonight's event, Dash Simmons from North Carolina steps into the ring with Nosa Divine Nehikhare from Nigeria. In the main event two undefeated welterweights Tahmir Smalls and Seantorius "Hardhead" Martin face off. Smalls with the reach advantageand 8 KO's looks to defeat Seantorius with 6 KO's under his belt.

programme.title: UFA 409 - Fighters Only 16th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 16th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas with host Chael Sonnen. This prestigious event celebrates outstanding achievements in MMA. Featuring numerous categories the event highlights the dedication and talent within the MMA community. Winners are determined by fan voting making this award show a unique reflection of the sport's global fanbase. Presenters include Bubba Jenkins, Brody Malone, Jake Ellenberger, Belal Muhammad, Ian Bohen, Derek Stevens, Arianny Celeste, Randy Couture, Caroline Pearce, Jon Anik, Kaz Egan, Megan Anderson, BJ Baldwin, Nina Drama, Will Yun Lee and Neal McDonough with special appearances by Jelly Roll, Dave Farra and Mark Coleman.

programme.title: UFA 416 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 1 from London. Watch as two veteran bare knuckle fighters Liam Wilson and Jonny Lawson step into the ring. Also on the card Ash Williams versus Joe Fitzpatrick in a British Titile Eliminator bout and Reece Murray versus Adam Grogan in a Bantamweight Title clash plus Ryan Barrett and Richard Samuels throwdown for the British Supermiddleweight crown.

programme.title: UFA 417 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 2 from London.First up in female bout Sweden's Mathilda Wilson faces Romania's Maria Nitescu for a rematch in a Title clash. Next up Carl Hobley and Dan Podmore step into the ring with a World Cruiserweight Title on the line. In the main event Scott McHugh and Aaron McCallum vye for the World Bantamweight Title belt.

programme.title: UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 1 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. In the first match, Gabe Sestan steps into the cage with Adam Cook followed by Reggie Morris versus Jackson Blankenship. Also on the card Ian Houston takes on Garrenn Lucas in the catchweight division plus Shaine Moffitt versus Kody McGehee in a lightweight bout. In the co-main event, Austin Miller, a kickboxer crosses over to MMA taking on Michael Banks.

programme.title: UFA 475 - Shamrock 370 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 2 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. Starting off this episode Noah Stockdale faces Emmanuel "Primetime" Primer in a kickboxing match. Next up Rohan Aibara steps into the cage with Cameren Harris while Jackson Henson takes on Tyreace Wilbourn in an MMA scrap both fighters making thier professional debut. The main event features undefeated prospect and hometown favorite Jacob Highley taking on Eric Beck one of the best wrestlers in the midwest.

programme.title: UFA 318 - Dynamite Fighting Show 18
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 18 from Romania. Starting things off Cosmin Bukoveanu looks to win this rematch when he faces Florin Ivanoaie "Thor" in a heavyweight matchup. Vali Petrut faces Cristian-Gabriel Conea in a heavyweight bout. In the co-main event, Brazilian Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Romanian and hometown favorite Bogdan Nastase and in the main event Flavius Boiciuc faces Andrei Ostrovanu.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Rajasthan vs Pune - Day 6 Tie 2
programme.desc: Witness a battle for survival at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai as two powerhouse teams, the Rajasthan Titans and Pune United, fight to secure their first tie victory of the season. The energy is palpable as Pune United's Katie Morris looks for redemption after a tough opening night, while the Titans rely on the aggressive play of Lorena Dupnik and the "superb power" of volleyball-pro-turned-pickleballer Isabella Nelson. From the intense "grind" of 15-minute singles matches to the high-speed tactical exchanges of men’s and women’s doubles, every point is a step toward climbing the league ladder. Don't miss the strategic masterclasses, including high-stakes challenges and game-changing "Pickle Plays," that keep the Mumbai crowd on the edge of their seats.

programme.desc: Day 7 of the World Pickleball League brings a critical and dramatic game between Mumbai Pickle Power and the Bengaluru Jawans. programme.title: Women's Doubles Open Final - Lock/Morris vs. Mendez/Carvajal
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the high-stakes Women's Doubles Open Final featuring Team England against Team Spain. Defending champions Spain, represented by the powerhouse duo of Sabrina Mendez and Glauka Carvajal, look to secure their second consecutive title against the English pair of Thaddea Lock and Katy Morris.

programme.title: NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - USD vs. GCU
programme.desc: We are live in sunny San Diego for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This high-stakes collegiate team match features the University of San Diego (USD) battling Grand Canyon University (GCU) in a best-of-seven series.The action includes intense Men's Doubles , Women's Singles , and Mixed Doubles as these teams compete for regional dominance. Watch top talent, including GCU's lefty powerhouse Adam Jones, who boasts a strong 5.6 singles rating , and his partner Xavier Cook Nakakuki. On the USD side, the episode highlights the partnership of Marcus Hopkins and Ryan, an impressive grad student player with high doubles ratings. USD’s Bella also shows grit in the women's singles match. This broadcast captures the best of college pickleball in an amazing format.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Rajasthan - Day 11 Tie 2
programme.desc: Experience the final showdown of the league stages as Delhi Dilwale and the Rajasthan Titans clash in a high-stakes battle for pride and final positioning. The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. Witness a tactical masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the relentless power of Max Mantor and the "next level" skills of Trang Huynh as they attempt to dismantle the Titans’ defensive wall. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.title: NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - GCU vs. Hawaii
programme.desc: We are live from the Barnes Tennis Center in San Diego, California, for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This thrilling collegiate team match features Grand Canyon University (GCU) taking on the University of Hawaii. The broadcast picks up in the heat of the action during a crucial mixed doubles game, with GCU leading. Watch as the match extends into a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7) to decide the winner. The episode highlights the unique collegiate format where every point counts towards seeding for the National Championship. Key players include Hawaii's Tristan Simmons and Tama, battling against GCU's Tanner and Hannah. The match concludes with a high-stakes finish that determines who moves forward in bracket play.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Rosati/Campbell
programme.desc: In this US Open 2025 Pro Women's Doubles match, the Waters duo (Anna Lee Waters and Lee Waters) take on Amanda Rosati and Kaitlyn Campbell. The commentators highlight the Waters' dominant performance, particularly Anna Lee's disguised shots and aggressive play, as they secure a swift victory. They also discuss the challenges of the progressive draw format in pickleball and preview Anna Lee Waters' upcoming mixed doubles match with Andre Agassi.

programme.title: WPBL 2025 - Bengaluru vs. Pune - Finals

programme.title: NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Kennesaw State vs. Virginia Tech
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025, this pivotal collegiate team match features Kennesaw State (KSU) facing off against Virginia Tech. The action kicks off with a mixed doubles showdown chosen by coin-toss winner Virginia Tech.Watch as Virginia Tech's Cody Miller and Heather Murphy bring their A-game against KSU's Yuri Yadi and Sophia Fiona. The match also features men's doubles with Kellen Funk and Cody Miller representing the Hokies, while Parth Modi and his partner fight to keep KSU's hopes alive. With crucial seeding for bracket play on the line, both teams battle through intense rallies and strategic plays in this pool play matchup.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Chennai - Day 1 Tie 2
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues its high-energy opening day at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a star-studded clash between Delhi Dilwale and the Chennai Super Champs. Watch as international stars like Delhi’s Max "Purple Jesus" Manthao and Chennai’s Hwang Nam Lee—a former Wimbledon junior doubles champion—bring world-class precision to the court. With celebrity co-owner Samantha cheering from the sidelines and strategic masterclasses from coach Wesley Gabrielsson, this tie features a gauntlet of intense Women’s Singles, Men's Singles, and high-speed Doubles matches. Experience every "Ernie" shot, tactical "pickle play," and the longest video challenge in league history as these two powerhouse teams battle for early-season dominance.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022 – Mixed Doubles – Patterson & Taylor vs Fudge & Anderson
programme.desc: The 2022 Picklebowl offers an unforgettable mixed doubles match featuring some of the biggest names in sports. US Olympian Casey Patterson and pickleball pro Chuck Taylor join forces to take on pickleball standout Megan Fudge and former tennis world No. 5 Kevin Anderson. Set against the scenic backdrop of Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event blends elite pickleball play with charity and college pride. Expect explosive rallies, pinpoint accuracy, and powerful serves in this high-energy exhibition that showcases the crossover appeal of pickleball.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Chennai vs Pune - Day 12 Tie 1
programme.desc: The stakes reach their absolute peak at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for the first semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2, where there are "no do overs" for the Chennai Super Champs and Pune United. Witness a high-stakes tactical chess match as Chennai’s coach Jonny Goldberg makes the bold move to start premier player Rika Fujiwara against the "big and aggressive" Katie Morris in a critical women's singles clash. The intensity continues with a masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the powerful pairing of Lee Hwang Nam and Carlota Trevino facing off against Pune's consistent stars, William Sobeck and Magdalena Gregorio. Every point is a desperate grind for survival as these two titans battle through "world class" rallies for a guaranteed spot in the grand finale.

programme.title: WPBL 2025 - Pune vs. Chennai - Day 6 Tie 1
programme.desc: It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

programme.title: English Open 2023 – Women’s Doubles 4.5+ Final – Fudge & Barr vs Whitwell & Bohnert
programme.desc: Experience the exciting Women's Doubles Open 4.5+ Final from the 2023 English Open held at Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. This match features dynamic teams: Megan Fudge and Susannah Barr face off against Lee Whitwell and Riley Bohnert in a highly competitive final. Follow expert commentary highlighting key plays including Susannah Barr’s precise lobs, Megan Fudge’s powerful forehand, and strategic teamwork. See how the match unfolds in a best-of-three games format with a hard stop on time. This showcase of top-level English pickleball captures the skill, tactics, and intensity of the sport. Stay tuned for post-match insights and upcoming mixed doubles action.

programme.title: Vanta Stingrays vs Leggetts Legends_Final
programme.desc: Megan Fudge and Amanda Hendry face Amelia Schmidt and Amber Pollicare in a pickleball match. Megan, a former field hockey player, and Jack Monroe discuss their preparation and excitement for the game.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - University of South Florida vs. Kansas Jayhawks
programme.desc: The intensity reaches a boiling point in Saint Louis as the NCPA Nationals transition to a high-stakes, single-elimination "win or go home" format. The University of South Florida Bulls and the Kansas Jayhawks take center stage in a best-of-seven battle where every point feels like a "Racing" sprint toward the championship crown. Watch as Austin King and Tessa Wilson utilize elite "Skills" to navigate a narrow center court, fending off a late-game surge by the Jayhawks to secure a hard-fought 11-8 victory. With the bracket tightening and powerhouses like Penn State and Michigan looming, this "Freestyle" display of collegiate talent proves that in the world of elite pickleball, there is zero room for error.

programme.title: Vanta Stingrays vs Yield Point Wranglers_Semifinal 1
programme.desc: Vanta Stingrays vs Yield Point Wranglers in Semifinal 1 at Pickleball Cayman. Watch the Stingrays, 1 seed, face off against the Wranglers. Highlights include intense gameplay, impressive shots, and Cayman deciders. Don't miss the action.

programme.title: Men's Doubles Final - Virginia vs. Texas
programme.desc: Jack Munro of Texas faces Virginia’s David Bieger in the 2024 DUPR National Championship Men’s Singles Final, showcasing skill, power, and precision in elite collegiate pickleball.

programme.title: NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 - Team Match - University of Wisconsin Madison vs. Purdue University
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 1, Day 1 of the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, live from The Pickler in Noblesville. This crucial Collegiate Team Match features the University of Wisconsin Madison battling a developing Purdue University squad. This match is pool play for seeding, with teams competing for one of eight bids to the National Championship and a share of the $5,000 prize money.

programme.title: Stingers vs Hotshots (Mixed)

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - Virginia Tech vs. Ohio State University
programme.desc: The pressure reaches a boiling point in Game 6 as Virginia Tech enters a must-win situation to keep their championship hopes alive against a dominant Ohio State squad. This episode showcases the high-speed "racing" volleys and technical "skills" of the Buckeyes as they ignite a massive scoring heater to take an early commanding lead. Not to be outdone, the Hokies demonstrate their "freestyle" resilience with powerful put-aways and a scrappy defensive effort to counter the Buckeye momentum. With special guest Michael McDonald providing expert analysis from the booth, every point becomes a tactical battle for collegiate pickleball supremacy.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Pro Men's Doubles - Yates/Sobex vs. Yu/Zwiren
programme.desc: In this Pro Men's Doubles match from the 2025 Minto U.S. Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida, the team of Yates and Sobex faces off against Yu and Zwiren. programme.title: Picklebowl 2022 - Mixed Doubles 1

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Mumbai vs Bengaluru - Day 5 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Mumbai Pickle Power face off against the Bengaluru Jawans in a high-stakes Tie 9. programme.title: 2026 Pickleball US Open – Friday Match 3 - Fudge/Devilliers vs. DeHeart/Koszuta
